title: Monkey Mart Idle
description: Run a lively cartoon supermarket staffed by energetic monkeys—harvest bananas, fill stalls, ring up shoppers, and unlock bustling new aisles.
controls: Drag on screen with the virtual joystick to move your monkey manager, harvest produce, restock stands, and collect coins.

zh-CN.title: 猴子集市
zh-CN.description: 全球爆火萌猴经营超市神作：操控小猴现摘香蕉玉米、搬运补货上架、收银数钱雇帮手，打造最热闹的森林百货集市！
zh-CN.controls: 按住拖动摇杆控制小猴移动，靠近果树自动采摘并搬运到货架与收银台收钱升级店铺。
